title: Scaffolded tasks feature uses r.crud
Managed bin/kumiko.ts and ci.yml fixes
kumiko check verifies test script timeouts
detail: The scripts step of `kumiko check` reads every `bun test` command in package.json, derives its variant from `--config` and fails when the effective `--timeout` (bun's default is 5000) differs from `TEST_TIMEOUT_MS` of that variant. Running `bunfig.integration.toml` through `bun test` directly and `test:integration*` scripts that do not call `bun kumiko-testing integration` fail too. Apps that adopted `defineAppConfig` fail, others get a warning.
migration: Set `--timeout` to the class value (`test:dom` 5000, `test:real` 240000) and delete app-level copies of this check such as `bun-test-timeout.test.ts`.

title: Scaffold subpaths for the CLI
Overrides of Kumiko packages fail the managed-files check
detail: `kumiko check-managed` reports every `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-*` or `@cosmicdriftgamestudio/kumiko-*` entry in `overrides` or `resolutions`. Published Kumiko packages pin each other exactly, so such an override only hides a version drift.
migration: Delete the Kumiko entries from `overrides` and `resolutions` and keep the exact pins in `dependencies`. Also delete overrides for html-to-text, nodemailer, sharp and happy-dom, which the framework now brings in patched versions.

title: Managed ci.yml covers e2e shards and full Chromium, checks run on pull requests only
detail: package.json#kumiko.deploy takes `e2eShards` (integer from 1, default 1) and `e2eChromiumFull` (default false); they render `shards` and `chromium-full: true` into the e2e job. In the private ci.yml the test and integration jobs run on pull_request and merge_group only, like e2e, and the build on the main push no longer needs them, because the pull request already gated the merge. The public ci.yml caches the bun install and runs `bun kumiko-guards comment-lang` and `bun kumiko agent lint` in the test job.
migration: Delete the `# kumiko-managed: local …` line in .github/workflows/ci.yml, rename jobs only this app needs to `app-<name>`, move shards and full Chromium to kumiko.deploy.e2eShards and kumiko.deploy.e2eChromiumFull and MinIO or Meilisearch to ports.infra (s3, meilisearch) in kumiko.config.ts, then run `kumiko sync-managed --write`. A public app needs English comments or a comment-lang baseline and a description on every agent-visible handler.

title: Managed CI follows the framework's infra tag unless the app sets infraRef
setupAppTestStack is the one app test entry
detail: The subpath `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/setup-test-stack-from-features` and the root re-exports of `setupTestStackFromFeatures`, `SetupTestStackFromFeaturesOptions` and `TestStackPreset` are removed. Apps use `setupAppTestStack` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-dev-server/testing`; packages use `setupTestStack` from `@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack`.
migration: Replace `setupTestStackFromFeatures(features, options)` with `setupAppTestStack(features, options)` and the type `SetupTestStackFromFeaturesOptions` with `SetupAppTestStackOptions`. setupAppTestStack defaults to `includeBundled: true` and `registryTables: true`; pass `includeBundled: false, registryTables: false` to keep the old defaults.

title: Managed kumiko/schema.ts and kumiko check read listDefaults
detail: The managed `kumiko/schema.ts` passes `appConfig.listDefaults` to `composeFeatures`, and `kumiko check` reports bin runners that leave out `listDefaults` while kumiko.config.ts sets it. `runDevApp` and `setupTestStackFromFeatures` take `listDefaults`.
migration: Run `kumiko sync-managed` to refresh kumiko/schema.ts, then rename the runner option in bin/.

title: App test stacks gate tiers like runDevApp
detail: `setupAppTestStack` now wires the tenantTierResolver of a mounted tier-engine (`createTierEngineFeature({ tierMap })`, `composeSaasStack({ tiers })`) the same way runDevApp and runProdApp do, including the trial gate and `featureToggles`. `ctx.hasFeature` and the dispatcher's feature gate are no longer always on in app tests, so a free-tier refusal test can fail. Breaking for app tests that call tier-gated handlers without assigning a tier: assign one with `tier-engine:write:tier-assignment:create`, or pass `effectiveFeatures` explicitly, which still replaces the resolver.
migration: App tests that call tier-gated handlers without assigning a tier assign one with `tier-engine:write:tier-assignment:create`, or pass `effectiveFeatures` to `setupAppTestStack`, which still replaces the resolver.

The dev server runs with row level security on
detail: runDevApp and createKumikoServer default to rowLevelSecurity "on" and run the dev stack as kumiko_app. On boot against a persistent dev database, the stack creates the role and transfers ownership of the database and of the public schema's tables, views and sequences to kumiko_app. The database user in DATABASE_URL needs the right to create roles, which the superuser of a local Postgres has. Code that reads tenant tables through a raw connection without a scope sees no rows in development; the boot does not detect this. runSchemaApply takes rowLevelSecurity, and the managed kumiko/schema.ts exports ROW_LEVEL_SECURITY from appConfig; the managed file updates on the next sync.
migration: Pass rowLevelSecurity: "off" to runDevApp while fixing code paths without tenant context; the dev database keeps kumiko_app as owner. A server entry written by an older scaffold passes appConfig.rowLevelSecurity to runProdApp by hand once the app turns row level security on. Manual migration, there is no codemod.

title: @app/define and kumiko codegen are removed
detail: The .kumiko/ codegen (define.ts, types.generated.d.ts, schemas.generated.ts) is gone: runCodegen, scanEvents and their types are no longer exported, the dev server no longer watches r.defineEvent calls, `kumiko codegen` is removed, `kumiko-build --check` is removed and kumiko-build no longer runs a codegen pass. The scaffolded .gitignore no longer lists .kumiko/, so the upgrade marker .kumiko/upgrade-state.json can be committed. ctx.appendEvent stays bound to the augmentable KumikoEventTypeMap; to emit an event with a payload checked against its definition use emitEvent(ctx, eventDef, { aggregateId, aggregateType, payload, headers? }) with the EventDef that r.defineEvent returns (emitEvent now also accepts headers).
migration: Replace `@app/define` imports with direct framework imports (defineWriteHandler/defineQueryHandler/defineFeature from @cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine, events via r.defineEvent and emitEvent) and drop the `file:./.kumiko` dependency plus the bunfig/tsconfig resolver entries. Known sites: publicstatus 43 files, kumiko-platform 13 (samples), solon 3, money-horse 1, phronexsis 1.

Deploy Dockerfile template: NPM_AUTH_TOKEN registry auth, manifest-first or full-tree install by detected layout, BUILD_VERSION/BUILD_TIME in the runtime stage, TZ=UTC; new kumiko-init-deploy bin with --force and a --check drift check
migration:
The scaffolded `deploy/Dockerfile` now declares `ARG NPM_AUTH_TOKEN`
(global + re-declared in the build stage) instead of `ARG GITHUB_TOKEN`,
and exports `ENV GITHUB_TOKEN=${NPM_AUTH_TOKEN}` in the build stage —
bunfig.toml/.npmrc still read `$GITHUB_TOKEN`, only the build-arg name
passed by CI changes. Apps that already generated `deploy/Dockerfile`
from an older template keep working unchanged; re-run
`kumiko-init-deploy --force` (or `kumiko init-deploy --force` from the
monorepo) to pick up the new wiring, the runtime stage's
`ARG BUILD_VERSION=dev`/`ARG BUILD_TIME=unknown` re-declaration (without
it the runtime `ENV BUILD_VERSION`/`ENV BUILD_TIME` stayed empty despite
a correct `--build-arg`), and `ENV TZ=UTC`.

The install step now copies manifests first (`package.json`, `bun.lock`,
and whichever of `bunfig.toml`/`.npmrc` exist) before `bun install`,
unless the app's `package.json` has a `workspaces` field or a
`file:`/`workspace:`/`link:` dependency spec, in which case it still
does `COPY . .` first (bun needs the whole tree to resolve the
lockfile).

`scaffoldDeploy`/`ScaffoldDeployOptions`/`ScaffoldDeployResult` keep
their existing shape and behavior. New: `renderDeployFiles` (pure,
no writes) and `checkDeployDrift` (read-only, reports missing/differing
files) are exported alongside `scaffoldDeploy`, which now calls
`renderDeployFiles` internally. `ScaffoldDeployDetected` gained
`installFromFullTree` and `registryConfigFiles`.

New `kumiko-init-deploy` bin (and `runInitDeployCli` export) — same
flags as `kumiko init-deploy` (`--app`, `--port`, `--github-org`,
`--out`, `--force`), plus `--check` (drift check, exit 1 on any
missing/differing file, does not write) and defaulting `--app` from
`package.json`'s `name` (scope stripped) when omitted. `--check` and
`--force` are mutually exclusive (exit 2). The monorepo's
`kumiko init-deploy` command now delegates to `runInitDeployCli`
instead of duplicating the CLI logic.

title: migrate-step.sh reads package.json#kumiko.deploy (dbUser, stackNetwork "discover" | "directory"); defaults unchanged, invalid values fail the render and the drift check

`stackNetwork`.
